title: What to consider when choosing your protection package.

sections.title: Loss damage waiver for collision damages, scratches, bumps, and theft
sections.text: Protect yourself from the high costs of vehicle damage and theft. With this waiver, SIXT reduces your liability to the specified excess for accidental damage to the bodywork, wheels, and undercarriage, and in the event of theft.

sections.title: Tyre and windscreen protection
sections.text: Don’t worry about glass or tyre damage. No matter whether a stone chip, cracks, or an overlooked nail — you are covered during your rental.

sections.title: Interior protection
sections.text: Interior protection lets you travel worry-free — no stress about spills or scratches, whether from kids or everyday use during your rental.

sections.title: Mobility service
sections.text: Be protected against the cost of accidental and self-inflicted situations: real-life mishaps that stop your trip, like lost keys, a dead battery, or an empty tank. SIXT guarantees you stay mobile 24/7 on the road.
